_why: OpV-B1 (docs/eras/opv.md, machines 1 and 2, lines 19, 34 and 35): the tetron fab and the gamma optics works. Read by server_scripts/grindless/opv/tetron_optics.js. Ids are grindless:<type>/<name>. Chance 1000 = 10 %; a charge is a fluid that is not consumed.

recipes._why: line 19, step 1: the gated InAs-Al 2DEG wafer is diced into four tetrons (two nanowires on a superconducting backbone), each with its cryo-CMOS readout
recipes.name: tetron_die

recipes._why: line 19, last step: four parity-tested tetrons and a HEMT readout amplifier are tied into an array in a superfluid He-3 bath (kept); a die that fails the array's interferometric parity calibration is pulled (10 %) and goes to the EV extraction cascade (c25)
recipes.name: tetron_array

recipes._why: line 35, last step: bent Ge and GaAs tiles are bonded into the rings of the aligned frame and set by Bragg angle; bent Ge tiles whose curvature relaxes are pulled (25 %) and goes back to the UEV megabar to be re-bent (c9)
recipes.name: laue_lens

recipes._why: line 34, last step: the WC/SiC multilayer is mounted on the superpolished SiC blank and figured to the synchrotron's reflectivity record; a mirror whose figure is off (10 %) goes to the UEV CVI furnace to be stripped and re-coated (c11)
recipes.name: gamma_multilayer_mirror
